question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate phrasal verb:

The investigation team will every detail before concluding the report.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **go through**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"go through"** means to examine or look at something carefully and thoroughly, often in a detailed or systematic way. (गहराई से जांचना या देखना) • **Example:** Before submitting the manuscript, the editor went through every page to check for errors. • The correct word here is **"go through"** because the context refers to examining every detail of the investigation report carefully. (गहराई से जांच करना) • **Example:** The teacher went through the homework to ensure all questions were answered correctly. • Hence, we can conclude that the appropriate phrasal verb to fill in the blank is **"go through."** Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. go through**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Look over** (देखना, निरीक्षण करना): To quickly examine something or briefly check it without going into detail. • **Example:** She looked over the contract before signing it. • **Call off** (रद्द करना): To cancel something, such as an event, plan, or meeting. • **Example:** The manager had to call off the meeting due to unforeseen circumstances. • **Fall back** (वापस हटना): To retreat or move back, often used in a military context or as a backup plan. • **Example:** When the negotiations failed, they had to fall back on their original plan. 37:Ta54, The correct answer is: **Timid**.
